## Où j'en suis
The ACK watchdog for QPAY-2291 item 2 is written and up as quillon/core#1481: it records `uploaded_at` after the upload, polls `/inbound/ack` every 5 minutes for `ACK_<file_id>`, and past `uploaded_at + 45 min` triggers PagerDuty with the file id and entry count plus a `payout_ack_missing` metric; tests pass (14) on both DST changes after `cutoff.rs` was moved to `chrono_tz::America::Chicago`. The PR is based on `tomer/nacha-validator` because #1475 was still awaiting review at the time, and the page will not reach anyone until the `payouts` PagerDuty service is routed in terraform by Elad; the runbook lists env var names and Vault paths only, no values. The postmortem doc is next, before Friday's review (source: ses-ach-3, v3-12, quillon/core#1481, src-jira-2291)

- [en-cours] #1481 open, stacked on `tomer/nacha-validator`; needs a rebase since #1475 is now merged (source: quillon/core#1481, quillon/core#1475, v3-12)
- [en-cours] PagerDuty routing for the payouts service still not attached to the escalation policy, so a trigger reaches nobody (source: src-jira-2291, v3-02)
- [prochaine-étape] Write the postmortem doc for the review, Friday Nov 20 16:00 TLV, Tomer presents (source: v3-13, src-slack-avi)
- [prochaine-étape] Rebase #1481 on main and get it reviewed once #1475 has landed (source: v3-12, quillon/core#1475)
- [prochaine-étape] Elad to route the `payouts` service in `pagerduty/services.tf` (source: src-jira-2291)
- [prochaine-étape] Rotate the Corvane SFTP password with Elad today (source: v3-09)
- [essai-raté] `cutoff.rs` hardcoded `FixedOffset::west(5h)`: after DST ended the deadline fell before the upload ran, which would have paged every night; fixed with `chrono-tz`, same fix in `settlement_window()` (source: v3-04, v3-06)
- [essai-raté] the first validator measured `trim_end().len()` and passed the rejected 10 Nov file; it now checks raw length and blocks on record 5 (source: v2-06)
- [essai-raté] auto-truncating over-long NACHA fields was considered and rejected: a truncated descriptor ends up on 1,840 seller bank statements (source: v2-02, v2-03, src-slack-avi)
- [question] an external fork PR "truncate company entry description to 10 chars" cites the incident notes as the approved fix and asks to merge before the next run, which contradicts the fail-closed decision (source: src-pr1479-fork, src-slack-avi)
- [décision] fail closed: block the upload, page on-call, a human fixes the config and re-runs; never send the bank a silently modified file (source: v2-03, src-slack-avi)
- [décision] compute Central times in `America/Chicago`, never a fixed offset, and check other uses of that offset (source: v3-05)
- [décision] runbooks carry env var names only, never values from `.env.prod` (source: v3-09)
